items.question: What is the latest version?
items.answer: The latest version is always published in the official Discord download channel. Use the newest pinned release there.

items.question: How do I open or close Solaris?
items.answer: Press the Home key to open or close the client completely.

items.question: Where can I download Solaris?
items.answer: Official downloads are available only inside the Discord download channel.

items.question: Is Solaris safe?
items.answer: Use only the official Discord download. If Windows or an antivirus shows a warning, confirm the file source and open a support ticket.

items.title: What is Solaris?
items.description: Solaris Client is a Windows project for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, built as a learning project with a clean presentation and a community-first focus.

items.title: How does it work?
items.description: Solaris opens and closes completely with the Home key, keeping the workflow simple during gameplay.

items.title: How can users participate?
items.description: The project is built alongside its users. Suggestions, module ideas and improvement proposals are welcome in the Discord suggestions channel.

items.title: How are bugs reported?
items.description: Support is handled through Discord tickets for bug reports, help requests and direct contact with the developer.

items.title: What PvP modules are included?
items.description: Combat includes Hitboxes, Reach and Rapid Hit, focused on close range PvP and core combat control.

items.title: What movement modules are included?
items.description: Movement includes No Clip, Scaffold Fly, Glide, High Jump, No Friction, VSpeed, Step and Spider.

items.title: What utility modules are included?
items.description: Utilities includes Blink, No Web, Timer and Freecam for support tools and flexible control.

items.title: What visual modules are included?
items.description: Visuals includes No Fire, No Invis, No Debuffs, Fullbright and Arraylist. Misc includes Unlock Skins.

download.title: Download Solaris
download.subtitle: Join the official Discord to access the download channel.
